title: Rapid Onboard Slate with Inline Code Playground
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design and deliver a compact onboarding slate for Hosted API that combines model selection, a request-builder flow, and an embedded code playground. Deliverables: annotated desktop + mobile screenshots, an optimized model selector overlay, step-by-step request composer visuals, three language code snippets (JavaScript, Python, curl) shown in the playground with live-like output state, and an accessibility pass for keyboard navigation and screen reader labels. This task focuses on assets for the 2025.02 console release and the docs quickstart page.
comments: 2025-02-05 - Kickoff: scoped deliverables with PM; primary goal is to reduce first-call time-to-success from 6 minutes to under 2 minutes via clearer visual affordances.

2025-02-06 - Early sketches: explored stacked vs. tabbed model selector; initial preference for tabbed (model families / size / cost). Shared Figma link and asked eng for feasibility on inline playground sandboxing.

2025-02-07 - Design iteration 1: created desktop slate with three-panel layout (model selector, request builder, preview). Added compact mobile collapse behavior. Uploaded to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/RedwoodOnboard/rapid-slate-2025
2025-02-09 - PM feedback (Marina Patel): prefer single-step CTA and reduce copy weight on first touch. Updated labels and microcopy in prototype.

2025-02-10 - Engineering review (ENG-4122): Liam confirmed code playground can render sanitized sample responses and suggested truncation for long streaming outputs. Linked PR for playground scaffolding: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3245

2025-02-11 - Accessibility pass: added ARIA labels for model selector options, keyboard focus states for request builder fields, and ensured color contrast >4.5. Shared test notes with accessibility engineer (J. Ortiz).

2025-02-12 - Ready for visual QA: exported annotated PNGs and a PDF containing overlay callouts. Requesting design review and final sign-off from PM and Docs. Next steps: hook screenshots into docs page and staging console for UX validation (staging link: https://staging.console.redwood.ai/onboard-quick).
